item.title: YouTube adds AI disclosure label to music tracks
item.description:
YouTube adds AI disclosure label to music tracks

YouTube is rolling out a “Made with AI” label for music tracks that were altered or fully generated using generative AI, beginning in the YouTube Music app and later expanding to the main YouTube app.

🔍 Overview

  • The label appears on tracks that were “altered or fully generated” with AI.
  • It mirrors YouTube’s existing process for applying AI labels to videos.
  • The goal is to give listeners clear information about AI‑generated music.

⚙️ How it works

  • Music partners must disclose generative AI use when uploading songs.
  • If no disclosure is provided, YouTube may use “other signals” to decide if a song is AI‑generated.
  • YouTube combines partner disclosures with its own detection tools to identify AI‑generated tracks.
  • When AI played a significant role, a label is shown directly on the player page.
  • Tapping the label opens a simple menu that shares more information.

🚀 Availability

  • The label is rolling out starting today in the YouTube Music app.
  • It will expand to the main YouTube app later.

📊 Industry context

Platform AI Label Action
Spotify Launched a voluntary AI label earlier this year and said it wouldn’t recommend songs from “AI personas.”
Apple Music Reportedly getting an AI tag.
Deezer Added a switch for filtering out AI tracks.
Bandcamp Banned AI music outright earlier this year.

💡 Why it matters

  • YouTube wants it to be as easy as possible for listeners to have the right information and clarity when it comes to the music they listen to.
  • The label helps differentiate AI‑generated content from human‑created music, supporting informed choice.

#YouTube #AI #Music #Labeling

Source: YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs

item.title: YouTube Announces AI Agent and New Creator Optimization Tools
item.description:
YouTube Announces AI Agent and New Creator Optimization Tools

At the annual Made on YouTube event, the company announced updates to the suite of AI-powered creator tools it first unveiled in 2025.

⚙️ Key details

YouTube is introducing an AI “agent” designed to optimize a creator’s channel in the background. Its capabilities include:

  • Catalog Monitoring: The tool monitors back catalogs for content that is trending, relevant to the news, or has taken on a new life, offering suggestions for title and thumbnail tweaks.
  • Content Generation: The agent can generate entire titles and thumbnails based on an uploaded video’s content.
  • Creator Feedback: Creators can request feedback from the tool regarding their own thumbnails.
  • Brand Pitching: According to Amjad Hanif, vice president of creator products at YouTube, the tool can create brand pitches by pulling demographic and audience data from a creator’s channel.

🧩 How it works

YouTube is introducing several A/B testing and optimization features to boost watch time:

Feature Function
Dynamic Thumbnails Assigns one of up to three uploaded images to different audience segments.
Video Testing Tests three versions of a video (e.g., different hooks or structures) with small audience segments.

Regarding video testing, Hanif says the system ensures the three versions are not “dramatically different.” Creators can manually select a “winner” version or allow YouTube to do so automatically after seven days.

#YouTube #AIagents #ContentCreation #VideoOptimization

Source: YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them

item.title: Google partners with MrBeast for multi-year Gemini and Fitbit promotion
item.description:
Google partners with MrBeast for multi-year Gemini and Fitbit promotion

Google has signed a multi-year partnership with Jimmy “MrBeast” Donaldson, one of YouTube’s biggest creators, to promote Gemini, Google Health, and the Fitbit Air across upcoming videos.

🔍 Overview

The deal marks a significant collaboration between Google and Donaldson, whose YouTube channel became the first to hit 500 million subscribers a couple of months ago. The partnership comes amid reported efforts by YouTube to keep prominent creators exclusive to its platform.

⚙️ Key details

  • Partnership scope: Multi-year agreement featuring Gemini, Google Health, and Fitbit Air
  • First video: Scheduled for September 5
  • Format: Wilderness survival challenge with Jimmy and his crew
  • Additional promotion: Donaldson will appear in a Gemini campaign from Google

🧩 How it works

The inaugural video will follow Donaldson and his crew as they attempt to survive extreme and treacherous climates. Teams will race to navigate three unforgiving landscapes:

  • The jungle
  • The desert
  • The Arctic

According to Google, participants will use Gemini to help them identify dangers, survive brutal weather changes, and stay one step ahead. Donaldson will also use a Fitbit Air in one of his upcoming challenges.

🚀 Availability

Element Detail
First video release September 5
Featured products Gemini, Google Health, Fitbit Air
Campaign type Multi-year partnership with dedicated videos and campaign appearance

💡 Why it matters

The partnership reflects broader platform dynamics in the creator economy. A recent Bloomberg report noted that YouTube has been offering prominent creators deals to keep their content exclusive to its site as more creators strike deals with Netflix.

#MrBeast #GoogleGemini #Fitbit #YouTube #AIpartnerships #creatoreconomy

Source: Google is sending MrBeast into the wilderness, armed with AI
